meta.notes: Each test has the Langfuse dataset-item shape: input, expected_output, metadata. metadata holds optional exact-match checks (regex, case-insensitive): must_include_all = every pattern must match; must_include_any = at least one must match; must_not_include = none may match. Run scripts/json_to_csv.py to produce data/mira_eval_dataset.csv for import into n8n (Sheet/Data Table) or Langfuse.

tests.input: Generate a project plan for the AI Adoption Project at ABCDE Ltd. Use the provided project description.
tests.expected_output: A DRAFT project plan for the ABCDE Ltd AI Adoption Project covering 24 weeks (6 months), 2026-03-30 to 2026-09-13, using the 8 phases from the timeline: 1 Project Initiation (wk 1-2: project charter signed off; team structure finalized); 2 Current State Analysis (wk 3-4: current systems audit report; gap analysis report); 3 Use Case Selection (wk 5-6: final list of prioritized use cases with success criteria); 4 Pilot Design (wk 7-10: working prototype models; data pipelines established); 5 Pilot Implementation (wk 11-14: pilot results report; user feedback and performance metrics); 6 Evaluation & Iteration (wk 15-16: updated models and process refinements); 7 Full Deployment (wk 17-22: full production rollout; training sessions completed); 8 Monitoring & Review (wk 23-24: project closure report; recommendations for future scaling). Goals stated ONLY as: reduce delivery delays by 15%, lower operational costs by 10%, improve service responsiveness. Scope: demand forecasting, route optimization, inventory management, customer support. Includes a key-risks section citing register IDs (e.g. R09, R01, R05). No goals or KPIs that are not in the description.

metadata.judge_criteria: Includes phases, milestones and a timeline that match project_timeline.csv. Goals are only the three in the description. No invented goals or KPIs. Includes a key-risks section citing R-IDs.

tests.input: Generate a project plan for: "We want to build a chatbot."
tests.expected_output: A clarification, not a plan. States the request lacks enough detail to build a plan and asks for: scope/goals of the chatbot, timeline, team size, and ideally target users, channels and deliverables. Contains no phases, schedule or timeline table.

metadata.judge_criteria: Flags the input as insufficient and asks for scope, timeline and team size. Does not generate a full plan.

tests.input: Generate a risk assessment for the AI Adoption Project at ABCDE Ltd. Use the provided project description.
tests.expected_output: A categorized risk matrix for the ABCDE Ltd project built from the risk register R01-R10 (at least 6 risks), each with category, risk, impact and mitigation, linked to the logistics/AI context (demand forecasting, route optimization, inventory, customer support). Highlights live signals: R09 Security (T024 blocked), R01 Data Quality (T006 overdue), R05 Ethical & Legal (T025 legal review in progress). No generic risks unrelated to the project.

metadata.judge_criteria: Categorized risk matrix with risk, impact and mitigation. Risks are relevant to logistics/AI adoption and come from the register. No generic unrelated risks.

tests.input: Generate a risk assessment for: "New project starting soon."
tests.expected_output: A clarification, not a risk assessment. States there is not enough information and asks for project details: domain, scope, goals, timeline, team/technology. Contains no risk IDs, no risk matrix and no project-specific risks.

metadata.judge_criteria: Flags the input as insufficient and asks for project details. Does not invent project-specific risks.

tests.input: Generate a weekly status report using the sample task board data for Sprint 3.
tests.expected_output: A Sprint 3 weekly status report (as of 2026-04-28) using actual task names. In Progress: T007 Shortlist AI use cases (Arjun Mehta, due 4/28), T025 Legal review of data usage (Sarah Lin, due 4/28). To Do: T008 Define success criteria for each use case (Sarah Lin, due 5/2), T009 Vendor evaluation for ML platform (James Wong, due 5/5). Done: none. Blockers/risks: T024 Security review Blocked (waiting for security team); T006 Identify data gaps carried over from Sprint 2, overdue since 4/21. Upcoming milestone: prioritized use-case list due 2026-05-10. Overall health Amber or Red with reason. No invented tasks.

metadata.judge_criteria: Shows Sprint 3 tasks by status (T007 and T025 In Progress; T008 and T009 To Do) using actual task names. Mentions blockers/carry-over (T024, T006). Gives overall health. No invented tasks.

tests.input: Generate a weekly status report for: "Things are going fine."
tests.expected_output: A clarification. States that no task data was provided or is available for this report and asks for the task board or project name. No task statuses, task IDs or progress percentages.

metadata.judge_criteria: States that no task data is available and asks for it. Does not fabricate statuses or progress percentages.

tests.input: What are the top 3 risks for the ABCDE Ltd project based on the risk data?
tests.expected_output: Top 3 risks from the register with evidence-based rationale: 1) R09 Security Vulnerabilities - T024 security review is Blocked; 2) R01 Data Quality & Availability - T006 data-gap analysis is overdue; 3) R05 Ethical & Legal Concerns - T025 legal review of customer data use still in progress at its due date. Each with impact and mitigation from the register. No risks outside R01-R10.

metadata.judge_criteria: Names three risks from the register with a stated ranking rationale based on project evidence (T024 blocked, T006 overdue, T025 legal review).

tests.input: Which tasks are blocked or at risk of missing their deadline based on the task board?
tests.expected_output: As of 2026-04-28: Blocked - T024 Security review of AI infrastructure (James Wong, due 5/26, waiting for security team availability). Overdue - T006 Identify data gaps and quality issues (Priya Nair, due 4/21, In Progress). Due today, not done - T007 Shortlist AI use cases (Arjun Mehta) and T025 Legal review of data usage (Sarah Lin). Due soon, not started - T008 Define success criteria (Sarah Lin, 5/2, depends on T007) and T009 Vendor evaluation for ML platform (James Wong, 5/5). Each with a suggested action. tests.input: Generate a project plan for a 2-week project with no details provided.
tests.expected_output: A clarification, not a plan. States a 2-week duration alone is not enough and asks for scope, goals and deliverables (and ideally team and constraints). No day-by-day or phased plan.

metadata.judge_criteria: Asks for scope, goals and deliverables. Does not produce a detailed plan from the timeline alone.

tests.input: Summarize the current project status: how many tasks are done, in progress, and to do?
tests.expected_output: Task board status (25 tasks): Done 5 (T001-T005), In Progress 3 (T006, T007, T025), Blocked 1 (T024), To Do 16 (T008-T023).

metadata.judge_criteria: Counts exactly match the CSV: Done 5, In Progress 3, Blocked 1, To Do 16, total 25.

tests.input: What milestones are coming up in the next 2 weeks based on the timeline?
tests.expected_output: Milestones in the next 2 weeks (2026-04-28 to 2026-05-12), from project_timeline.csv: Phase 3 Use Case Selection - 'Final list of prioritized use cases with success criteria', due 2026-05-10. No other milestones fall in this window (Phase 2 ended 2026-04-26; Phase 4 milestones are due 2026-06-07). No milestones outside the timeline.

metadata.judge_criteria: Lists the Phase 3 milestone due 2026-05-10 from project_timeline.csv. Invents no milestones and lists none outside the 2-week window as upcoming.

tests.input: Generate a stakeholder update email summarizing Sprint 2 progress.
tests.expected_output: A professional stakeholder email (subject, greeting, summary, next steps) covering Sprint 2 only: Done - T004 Audit existing data infrastructure, T005 Map current logistics workflows; In Progress/overdue - T006 Identify data gaps and quality issues (due 4/21) with a plan to close it. Mentions no Sprint 3 or later tasks.

metadata.judge_criteria: Professional stakeholder email covering only Sprint 2 (T004, T005 done; T006 in progress/overdue). No Sprint 3+ tasks.

tests.input: Which risks have mitigation tasks assigned, and which don't?
tests.expected_output: Mitigation coverage for R01-R10 as of 2026-04-28. Mitigation at risk: R09 Security (T024 Security review is Blocked) and R01 Data Quality (T006 Identify data gaps is overdue). Weak coverage: R03 Talent/Skills (T020 staff training, weak link) and R06 Cost Overruns (T009 vendor evaluation, weak link). Covered, on track: R02 (T015, T019, T021), R04 (T016, T020), R05 (T025), R07 (T008), R08 (T022), R10 (T009). No risks without mitigation tasks. Only real risk and task IDs.

metadata.judge_criteria: Groups risks by mitigation coverage using the risk register links: R09 and R01 mitigation at risk, R03 and R06 weak coverage, the rest covered and on track. Cites the mitigation task IDs. Extra test added for a likely leadership question (not in the brief).

tests.input: Generate a project plan for the ABCDE project with an owner and budget for each phase.
tests.expected_output: A DRAFT project plan with the 8 phases, dates, activities and milestones from the timeline and the 3 stated goals, as in T1. Owners and budgets are NOT in the project data, so each phase's owner and budget is shown as UNKNOWN and listed under Open questions. No invented names, amounts or currencies.

metadata.judge_criteria: Plan grounded in the timeline and description; owner and budget marked UNKNOWN (not invented) and listed as open questions.

tests.input: What is the likelihood score of risk R05 for the ABCDE project?
tests.expected_output: States that the risk register has no likelihood (or severity) scores, so a likelihood score is UNKNOWN / not available. May give R05's actual details from the register: Ethical & Legal Concerns - risks of biased models or data privacy violations; impact: legal repercussions and reputational damage; mitigation: involve legal early and implement fairness checks; mitigation task T025 Legal review of data usage (In Progress, due 4/28). Does not invent a score, percentage or rating.

metadata.judge_criteria: Says no likelihood score exists in the data; does not invent one; any R05 details match the register.

tests.input: Generate a weekly status report for Sprint 42 using the task board.
tests.expected_output: States that there are no tasks for Sprint 42 on the task board (the board has Sprints 1-10), so no report can be produced for it. Does not invent tasks, statuses, counts or health for Sprint 42. May ask which sprint the user meant.

metadata.judge_criteria: Says Sprint 42 has no tasks / doesn't exist; invents no tasks, counts or health.

tests.input: Draft a stakeholder update email for the leadership team.
tests.expected_output: Does NOT draft an email. Asks which sprint the update should cover, and asks the user to resend the request with the sprint (e.g. 'Draft a stakeholder update email for Sprint 2.'). Nothing is sent to Slack or email.

metadata.judge_criteria: Asks which sprint instead of drafting; no email draft; no invented tasks.
